VK_CLOUD_DNS_ENDPOINT.title: VK_CLOUD_DNS_ENDPOINT
VK_CLOUD_DNS_ENDPOINT.description: URL of DNS API. Defaults to https://mcs.mail.ru/public-dns but can be changed for usage with private clouds

VK_CLOUD_DOMAIN_NAME.title: VK_CLOUD_DOMAIN_NAME
VK_CLOUD_DOMAIN_NAME.description: Openstack users domain name. Defaults to `users` but can be changed for usage with private clouds

VK_CLOUD_IDENTITY_ENDPOINT.title: VK_CLOUD_IDENTITY_ENDPOINT
VK_CLOUD_IDENTITY_ENDPOINT.description: URL of OpenStack Auth API, Defaults to https://infra.mail.ru:35357/v3/ but can be changed for usage with private clouds

VK_CLOUD_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: VK_CLOUD_POLLING_INTERVAL
VK_CLOUD_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 2)

VK_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID.title: VK_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID
VK_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID.description: String ID of project in VK Cloud

VK_CLOUD_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: VK_CLOUD_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
VK_CLOUD_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 60)

VK_CLOUD_TTL.title: VK_CLOUD_TTL
VK_CLOUD_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 60)
